piping_discovery_host_inspection.title: Inspect the host
piping_discovery_host_inspection.description: Read running services, processes, containers and listening sockets over the run connection. Disabling this source leaves the endpoint probe as the only evidence.

piping_discovery_endpoint_probe.title: Probe metrics endpoints
piping_discovery_endpoint_probe.description: Probe declared and discovered metrics endpoints from the Piping backend, independently of host inspection. This does not prove Prometheus scraper reachability.

piping_discovery_detect_exporter_type.title: Resolve exporter type
piping_discovery_detect_exporter_type.description: Resolve the exporter type from declared catalog assignments and typed machine identifiers (unit, service, executable, container image). A response alone never assigns a type.

piping_discovery_excluded_hosts.title: Excluded hosts
piping_discovery_excluded_hosts.description: Inventory host names or addresses that discovery skips. An excluded host yields a skipped observation, never an absence.

piping_discovery_excluded_ports.title: Excluded ports
piping_discovery_excluded_ports.description: TCP ports that discovery never probes.

piping_discovery_extra_endpoints.title: Additional endpoints
piping_discovery_extra_endpoints.description: Extra endpoints to probe in addition to declared assignments and discovered listeners. Each entry must address a host in the run target set.

piping_discovery_labels.title: Observed labels
piping_discovery_labels.description: Labels attached to observations produced by this run. Configured assignment labels stay separate and are never overwritten.

piping_discovery_probe_timeout_ms.title: Probe timeout
piping_discovery_probe_timeout_ms.description: Connect and response timeout for one endpoint probe in milliseconds.

piping_discovery_probe_concurrency.title: Probe concurrency
piping_discovery_probe_concurrency.description: Number of endpoint probes executed in parallel per host.

piping_discovery_max_endpoints_per_host.title: Endpoint cap per host
piping_discovery_max_endpoints_per_host.description: Maximum endpoints probed for one host. A truncated set is reported as partial and can never prove absence.

piping_discovery_rest_timeout.title: Piping REST timeout
piping_discovery_rest_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for the discovery report request made from the playbook.

piping_discovery_rest_retries.title: Piping REST attempts
piping_discovery_rest_retries.description: Number of attempts for the discovery report request. Keep this low for large target sets.

piping_discovery_command_timeout.title: Inspection command timeout
piping_discovery_command_timeout.description: Per-command timeout in seconds for bounded host inspection commands.

piping_discovery_absence_policy.title: Absence policy
piping_discovery_absence_policy.description: Manual keeps service discovery unchanged when an exporter is confirmed absent. Automatic is an explicit opt-in that may exclude only source-owned assignments after the confirmation window.

piping_discovery_absence_confirm_runs.title: Absence confirmation runs
piping_discovery_absence_confirm_runs.description: Consecutive complete runs with confirmed absence required before an automatic exclusion.

piping_discovery_restore_on_reappearance.title: Restore on reappearance
piping_discovery_restore_on_reappearance.description: In automatic mode, restore a source-owned assignment when the same endpoint is confirmed discovered again.
